Exec consent:
  ⚠ no runtime.test_command is configured, so the loop commands refuse.
    Fix: `dross project set runtime.test_command "<cmd>"`, then `dross trust`.
  Authorizes the dross commands that spawn a process: changes record, state bump, survivor drain, task next, task status in_progress, test, verify, verify results.
  The gated surface is enumerated from the source, not listed here; a spawn that
  cannot reach repo-authored code carries a //dross:exec-exempt <reason> marker.

Remote:
  ⚠ no remote granted — mutation runs and `dross test` run on this machine.
    Grant one with `dross remote grant <host> <workdir>`.

Mutation toolchain:
  ⚠ npx is not installed — the stryker adapter needs it to measure TypeScript/JavaScript/Svelte files here.
    Without it a verify run reports nothing measured rather than a bad score. Fix: install Node 20+ (https://nodejs.org) — npx ships with it
  ⚠ gremlins is not installed — the gremlins adapter needs it to measure Go files here.
    Without it a verify run reports nothing measured rather than a bad score. Fix: go install github.com/go-gremlins/gremlins/cmd/gremlins@latest
  ⚠ dotnet is not installed — the stryker-net adapter needs it to measure C# files here.
    Without it a verify run reports nothing measured rather than a bad score. Fix: install the .NET SDK (https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download)
